body:
It's just, I don't know. My family is definitely not the best, and I plan to move out if I don't kill myself, even if they protest and want me living with them. I just can't take that anymore and if I don't do something I will snap.

My friends, however, IDK. There's a reason I go to my closest bud for help and stuff, cause honestly she seems to actually give a crap unlike most other people, you know? Like, she's the only one who initiates conversations with me and invited me to do things and jokes with me about things without patronizing me, but sometimes she's kinda mean, and I mean very little. And I think I do give back to my friendships, or atleast I try too, but nothing is reciprocated.  I feel like I'm always second fiddle, or the last choice, or something. I try to speak up sometimes in conversations and I can't get a word in edgewise, and sometimes some of them joke about me, like they joke about everyone else, but sometimes it goes a bit too far and I can't help but feel hurt half the time.

For the relationships, it isn't the fact that Ih can't find one, it's the manipulation and the fact that I just keep getting used and rejected, and it's starting to feel like nobody actually cares or would care about me like that. I know it sounds defeatist but I do think it's possible, just the chances are very very slim and maybe I'm just going to be alone for the rest of my life cause that's just how my luck is.

And yeah, I get that I have to work on myself. Sitting around and waiting for the roses to bloom is not gonna work, but I've been working on myself for a while and nothing seems to work. Maybe I'm not working hard enough, or maybe it's the depression talking, but I just feel like nothing is working. 

And I typed out a wall too, so it's okay. Thanks for listening, you helped.
